subject.title: fix #100368: mark undelivered message_tool_only finals in replay

question: Should the hidden custom transcript notice become OpenClaw's canonical durable representation of an undelivered `message_tool_only` final across every runner path?
rationale: Even after repairing the sibling path, this changes persisted model-consumed context and therefore requires explicit acceptance of the compatibility and session-history semantics.

options.title: Adopt one shared durable marker
options.body: Persist the same session-guarded notice for direct and queued follow-up stranded finals and retain it through replay.

options.title: Use a non-persistent representation
options.body: Avoid a custom transcript record and represent delivery status only while constructing later model or provider context.

recommendation.title: Adopt one shared durable marker
recommendation.body: Persist the same session-guarded notice for direct and queued follow-up stranded finals and retain it through replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current recovery behavior whose durable context contract this PR would extend.
